description: NaMgH₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six H¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.56 Å. Mg²⁺ is bonded to six H¹⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing MgH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-28°. There are four shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) Mg-H bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H¹⁻ sites. In the first H¹⁻ site, H¹⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Mg²⁺ atoms. In the second H¹⁻ site, H¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Mg²⁺ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing HNa₂Mg₂ tetrahedra.
